laat_vaar.voor: Die boere het ook koper bewerk, 'n rooibruin metaal wat sagter as yster is.
laat_vaar.na: Die boere het ook koper bewerk. Koper is 'n rooibruin metaal wat sagter as yster is.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The apposition is separated from 'koper' by the verb, which reads awkwardly for Grade 5; two short sentences say the same thing more clearly.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: An apposition after the verb is normal Afrikaans word order and reads clearly, so the split is a lateral move, and it puts 'koper' in three sentences running and leaves the next sentence's 'hulle' further from 'Die boere'.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Met blaasbalke is lug deur blaaspype ingeblaas
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Met blaasbalke het hulle lug deur blaaspype in die oond geblaas
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Active voice with 'hulle' (the farmers of the previous sentence) is clearer for Grade 5, and 'ingeblaas' does not say into what; the glossary already says the air goes into the furnace.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The passive already reads clearly, the proposal is longer, and 'die oond' brings in a second word for the protected video term 'smeltoond'.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: al klink die woord smeltoond so
laat_vaar_vorige.na: al laat die woord smeltoond dit so klink
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: More idiomatic way to say the word makes it sound that way; the protected negation 'nie vloeibaar geword nie' is untouched.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'al klink die woord smeltoond so' is natural Afrikaans; the proposal is longer and only reads differently, in the sentence carrying the protected negation.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Van koper en ook van yster
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The repeated 'en ook van' is wooden; 'Van koper en yster' says the same thing more smoothly.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'en ook van yster' deliberately stresses that iron, not only copper, was used for ornaments; the original reads acceptably and the cut loses that emphasis.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: metaalwerk was die mans se taak
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Avoids 'werk' three times in one sentence (werk, metaalwerk, werk) without changing the meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'mans se werk' is natural Afrikaans in deliberate parallel with 'die werk ... verdeel', and 'die mans se taak' is a lateral swap that nudges toward all the men, against the next sentence's 'nie elke man ... net sekere mans'.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'vir ruilhandel gebruik' is the more natural preposition with 'gebruik'; the protected word stays.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'in ruilhandel gebruik' (used in barter) is correct and natural, while 'vir' shifts toward purpose (made or used for barter), so the preposition swap is lateral at best.
